_comment: Generated by scripts/gen-routes-contract.mjs from the server router: the gate class every route is held to (auth/routeContract.js). routes.contract.test.js fails when a route is missing here or carries a weaker gate than recorded. After a route change: npm run gen:routes-contract, then review the diff: a class that went DOWN is the change to look at.

GET /.well-known/microsoft-identity-asso.reason: /.well-known discovery-documenten (Azure publisher-domain, security.txt) — per definitie publiek

GET /.well-known/security.txt.reason: /.well-known discovery-documenten (Azure publisher-domain, security.txt) — per definitie publiek

GET /^\\/(?:([a-z]{2,3})\\/)?search-inde.reason: the public site search index, built from published pages (routes/publicSearchIndexRender.js)

GET /ai/model-costs.reason: modelkostentabel; de header van routes/ai/config/modelCosts.js noemt hem expliciet "public read" — config/updates ernaast zijn requireAuth/admin

GET /api.reason: API-naamkaartje ({ name, status }) — geen data, geen sessie nodig

GET /api/billing/public-plans.reason: publieke prijstabel voor de marketing-/signup-flow; de rest van /api/billing is requireAuth per route

GET /api/branding/public.reason: publieke branding (naam/logo/kleuren) voor login- en marketingpagina — nodig vóór er een sessie is

GET /api/branding/wallpaper/:filename.reason: wallpaper-asset behorend bij de publieke branding hierboven

GET /api/cms/^\\/asset\\/(.+)$/.reason: assets of published marketing pages (sanitised SVG, raster images) served from the CMS asset keys (routes/cmsAssets.js)

GET /api/cms/^\\/og\\/([a-z]{2,3})\\/([a.reason: og:image for a published page, rendered from the published snapshot only (routes/cmsOgImage.js)

GET /api/cms/blog/posts.reason: published blog posts of the live site, for the public blog page (routes/cmsBlog.js reads the published snapshot only)

GET /api/cms/site.reason: gepubliceerde CMS-site-payload voor de marketingpagina — de rest van /api/cms zit achter router.use('/admin'|'/sites', requireAdmin)

GET /api/cms/stories.reason: published customer stories of the live site, for the public page (routes/cmsStories.js, published snapshot only)

GET /api/dsr/requests/:id/public.reason: status-URL uit de ontvangstbevestiging van POST /api/dsr/requests — het request-id is de (onraadbare) credential van de indiener

GET /api/guard/health.reason: statusprobe van de PII-guard-service, zelfde klasse als /api/health — meldt configured/available, geen gebruikersdata

GET /api/integrations/gdrive/files.reason: als gmail/messages: Drive-client komt uit req.session-tokens, anoniem → 401 NOT_CONNECTED (routes/integrations/googleDrive.js)

GET /api/integrations/gmail/messages.reason: leest uitsluitend via de OAuth-tokens ín de sessie (createGoogleApiClient(req.session)) — zonder sessie is het antwoord 401 NOT_CONNECTED; er is niets om van een ander te lezen.

GET /api/integrations/google/callback.reason: OAuth-callback — redirect van de IdP, noodzakelijk bereikbaar vóór er een sessie is; state/code-validatie in de handler

GET /api/languages/public/locales.reason: i18n: beschikbare talen voor login-/marketingpagina — vóór er een sessie is

GET /api/public-app/:token.reason: publieke intake van een Studio-app: het URL-token is de credential en ontsluit alleen de whitelist van schermen in de app-definitie (appStudio/publicAccess.js); bezoekers zijn per ontwerp anonieme derden

GET /api/public/github-stats.reason: anoniem marketing-endpoint (github-stats-blok op de publieke site), zegt het al in zijn mountnaam

GET /api/release-notes/public.reason: serveert alleen PUBLISHED entries; machinaal geschreven copy passeert eerst een mens via /admin/:id/publish (index.js-commentaar)

GET /api/support/csat/:threadId/done.reason: tokenloze bedankpagina na een CSAT-stem: vaste tekst uit het score-getal in de query, leest en schrijft geen thread. Bestaat zodat de stem-URL (mét token) na gebruik wordt vervangen door een URL zonder.

GET /api/support/threads/mine.reason: de eigen supporttickets van de ingelogde gebruiker. Geen keten-gate omdat /api/support ook anonieme marketing-intake draagt, maar de handler weigert zelf: geen userId → 401, en de query is gescoped op requesterUserId — er is niets van een ander te lezen. De handler-probe ziet dit patroon niet omdat getUserId(req) buiten haar werkwoordenlijst valt en er geen req.session in de body staat; dat is een gat in de PROBE, niet in de route.

GET /auth/callback.reason: SSO callback — the identity provider is the authenticator. The session.isAdmin touch is post-login session shaping, not a gate.

GET /auth/connector/bootstrap/pending/:i.reason: polls the approval state of a pending binding; the random id is the credential and yields status only, never the tenant key (auth/connectorBootstrap.js header)

GET /auth/invite/:token.reason: invitation preview for the signup form: the mailed token is the credential; shows the org name and the invited address only (auth/login/inviteRoutes.js)

GET /auth/login.reason: legacy Nextcloud login entry: starts the OAuth round trip for the Nextcloud app (auth/oauth/nextcloudLegacyRoutes.js); the provider is the authenticator

GET /auth/login-pickup.reason: one-time claim of the session token an OAuth popup deposited under a pickup id, for iframes that cannot see the cookie (auth/oauth/loginPickupRoutes.js); the id is minted per login

GET /auth/login/:provider.reason: OAuth login start: writes state and PKCE to the pre-auth session and redirects to the identity provider (auth/oauth/providerLoginRoutes.js)

GET /auth/organizations/public.reason: the organisations that allow self-signup, for the signup form: names only, needed before any session (auth/login/signupIntakeRoutes.js)

GET /auth/pending-invite.reason: reads the invitation parked on the caller's own pre-auth session by the redeem link; nothing of anyone else (auth/login/inviteRoutes.js)

GET /auth/redeem-invite/:token.reason: invitation redeem link from the mail: parks the token on the pre-auth session and redirects to signup (auth/login/inviteRoutes.js)

GET /auth/setup-status.reason: first-run probe for the setup screen: answers only whether an operator account exists yet; the login page needs it before any session

GET /auth/verify-email/:token.reason: e-mail verification link: the mailed token is the credential, single-use (auth/login/emailVerificationRoutes.js)

GET /integrations/:id.reason: server-rendered public page of one integration, same source as the directory (routes/publicIntegrationsRender.js)

GET /integrations/directory.reason: server-rendered public integrations directory of the marketing site (routes/publicIntegrationsRender.js)

GET /share/_brand/icon.svg.reason: statisch brand-icoon op de publieke share-pagina's — de inhoudsroutes van /share zijn share-token-gated in routes/publicViewer.js

GET /verify/:token.reason: certificaatverificatie voor LinkedIn-shares — token-gated (alleen bewust publiek gezette certs resolven), per-IP rate limited (routes/verifyCertificate.js)

GET /w/_brand/icon.svg.reason: zelfde statische brand-icoon, tweede mount: routes/publicViewer.js hangt sinds W3 stap 4 óók op /w/<slug> (het adres van de pagina in plaats van dat van de share) — één router, één poort, dus dezelfde reden

POST /api/client-errors.reason: anonieme client-fouttelemetrie mét rate limiter in de router — fouten vuren ook vóór/zonder sessie

POST /api/cms/forms/:blockId.reason: public form submission from a published page: honeypot, HMAC token with issue time, nonce replay refusal, per-IP and per-form limits (routes/cmsForms.js)

POST /api/csp-report.reason: CSP-violation-reports van de browser — de browser stuurt ze zonder credentials; 32kb-limiet in de router

POST /api/dsr/requests.reason: DSR-inname: een betrokkene zonder account moet een verzoek kunnen indienen (GDPR Art. 12); per-IP publicSubmitLimiter in de router, admin-kant zit achter requirePermission.

POST /api/stripe/webhook.reason: Stripe-webhook — authenticatie is de Stripe-handtekening over de raw body (mount vóór bodyParser, index.js), geen sessie.

POST /api/web-vitals.reason: Core Web Vitals-beacons; header zegt het zelf: TTFB/FCP vuren vóór de sessie bestaat. Sinds 2026-09-05 met dezelfde per-IP rate limiter als client-errors (60/min: één page load = tot vijf metric-beacons).

POST /auth/admin-login.reason: The login endpoint itself — necessarily reachable by anyone, since authenticating is what it is for. loginThrottle.checkLoginAllowed(req, username) at the top of the body is ABUSE RESISTANCE, not authorization: it answers "has this identifier failed too often lately?" and never grants or withholds access to a resource. It was added after a pentest sent 120 failed logins in two seconds and received 120 × 401. A probe hit here is expected and is not a gate.

POST /auth/connector/bootstrap.reason: connector pairing: the handler verifies the calling Nextcloud by its capabilities round trip and, for an instance that is already bound, proof of that binding (the recorded base URL or a tenant-key signature, auth/connector/rebindProof.js) or a pairing code, before it answers anything (auth/connectorBootstrap.js)

POST /auth/connector/bootstrap/pending/:.reason: resends the verification mail for a pending binding, rate limited per IP (auth/connectorBootstrap.js)
changes the address the verification mail goes to, under the same pending-binding id and limiter (auth/connectorBootstrap.js)
redeems the e-mailed verification code for a pending binding: the code is the credential, attempts are capped (auth/connectorBootstrap.js)

POST /auth/connector/diagnose.reason: connector diagnostics: the same capabilities round trip as bootstrap, answers reachability and binding state only (auth/connectorBootstrap.js)

POST /auth/forgot-password.reason: password reset request: always answers 200, mails a one-hour hashed token, throttled per address and IP (auth/login/passwordResetRoutes.js)

POST /auth/logout.reason: ends the caller's own session; without a session it is a no-op answered 200 (auth/login/profileRoutes.js)

POST /auth/mfa/security-key/options.reason: second-factor step of a login: works only on a session that holds mfaPending from the password step (auth/securityKeys/loginRoutes.js)

POST /auth/mfa/security-key/verify-login.reason: second-factor step of a login: the WebAuthn assertion is the credential, checked against the mfaPending user (auth/securityKeys/loginRoutes.js)

POST /auth/opaque/login/finish.reason: second half of the OPAQUE password exchange: the OPAQUE proof is the credential, bound to the state /opaque/login/start put on the session (auth/opaqueRoutes.js)

POST /auth/opaque/login/start.reason: The OPAQUE half of the login endpoint — anonymous by necessity, same as POST /auth/admin-login. loginThrottle.checkLoginAllowed(req, username) in the body is ABUSE RESISTANCE, not authorization. It was added when this route turned out to have been left out of the login hardening entirely: it answered 401 for an unknown name, 400 {useLegacy} for a legacy one and 200 for an OPAQUE one, which made it an account-existence oracle needing no timing measurement. Absent accounts now get a fake credential (see opaqueRoutes.js) and the handshake fails at login/finish. Verified by auth/opaqueRoutes.enumeration.test.js.

POST /auth/pending-invite/clear.reason: clears the invitation parked on the caller's own pre-auth session (auth/login/inviteRoutes.js)

POST /auth/resend-verification.reason: resends the verification mail to the address on file; answers the same whether the address exists, throttled (auth/login/emailVerificationRoutes.js)

POST /auth/reset-password.reason: password reset completion: the e-mailed token is the credential, compared by hash and single-use (auth/login/passwordResetRoutes.js)

POST /auth/setup.reason: first-run operator setup: refused by the handler as soon as an operator account exists (auth/login/setupRoutes.js), after that the route is inert

POST /auth/signup.reason: Public signup. checkWebSignupAllowed() is org policy (is signup open?), NOT authorization — a probe hit here is expected and is not a gate.
